device.model: HD T90, STB HD N2 and STB HD N3 (one update for the three)
device.tuner: the boards' own: a Rafael Micro R820T on the Globo N3 (I2C 0x1A); the update's driver is the same R828 reference driver

image.version: 1.3.2 PVR (maincode "M3801 DVBT" 2015-1-5, name 406000000003002); defaultdb and userdb 2015-1-5
image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (Libcore 1.1.6, jessie.wei, Fri Jun 15 2012 -- dump_maciej.bin's), HDCPKey 0x04FE00 (1.01), maincode 0x050000 (LZMA), Radioback 0x290000, defaultdb 0x2A0000, userdb 0x2BFF80 -- the Opticum N2 / Globo N3 layout; the full 4 MB flash

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the official download)
source.note: The manufacturer's USB update "Software Decoder STB HD T90 N2-3 1.3.2PVR 2014-01-05.abs" as Opticum / Globo published it (the zip software-decoder-stb-hd-t90-n2-3-1-3-2pvr-2015-01-06.original.zip, once on opticum.com.pl / globo.com.pl and skymaster.de's uploads, which no longer serve it), with its Polish / English changelog README_CZYTAJ_TO!!!!.txt (1.2.4 .. 1.3.2); fetched 2026-10-11 from the mirror.

simulator.note: Boots and draws (2026-10-11): the bootloader's "success!" at 90 s, the application banner right after (Libcore 8.13.0@SDK4.0bd.8.13_20130731, Application 1.0.0@SDK4.0ba.7.4_20120227), the first GE commands 3 minutes in, about 960 by 4 minutes and then some 3 a second for ever: it tunes a channel of the update's list and, with no signal, shows the Globo N3's red "Brak sygnału" box (run_dump_t90_capture_screen.py, expected screen made 2026-10-11). The remote reaches it: MENU on that screen drew 28 GE commands and changed 60,000 pixels (the Globo N3's menu changes 200,000), so its menu steps are not in the test yet.

desc: The official 1.3.2 PVR update (main code dated 5 January 2015) for the Opticum HD T90 and the Opticum / Globo STB HD N2 and N3 -- the family of dump_maciej.bin (an N2, 2013 firmware) and the Globo N3 dump (2014 firmware): the same bootloader build, the same main-code name 406000000003002, two newer application versions.

Its changelog (README_CZYTAJ_TO!!!!.txt in the zip): 1.3.2 Slovak translations; 1.3.1 Slovak language, a simple / advanced sort mode, a fix for user settings changing by themselves; 1.3.0 Croatian; 1.2.9 backup to USB, channel-list upgrade, an "application defender" that restores factory defaults after three failed starts of channel playback, unified signal bars; 1.2.7 Greek fixes, the wizard's time zone; 1.2.6 timeshift to record, an LCN monitor for the Polish DVB-T offer; 1.2.5 audio on the second multiplex, DAY+/DAY- in the EPG, scan settings split into basic and advanced, the LED display as in 1.2.2; 1.2.4 channel opening time, the last UHF frequency, timers lost on power failure, the front panel's resolution display.
The image carries a userdb chunk (0x140070 bytes, like the dumps'), so the update does not wipe the channel list.
